guardrails: V19 is diagnostic only; it must not change agent routing.
An agent-effect estimate requires all four crossover cells: A/task1, A/task2, B/task1, B/task2.
Exploration outcomes must come from the exact V18 routing generation and agent.
Baseline comparators must be completed generated primary routes from non-applied V18 generations and must match the exact work_item_id.
Repeated routing generations for the same agent/task cell are aggregated within one crossover group and do not count as independent task pairs.
Work-steal, manual-override, retrospective, unmatched-claim, and incomplete routes are excluded.
Task difficulty and agent effect are reported separately under an additive crossover contrast.
No estimate may be created from missing cells, unmatched slot identity, or inferred task identity.
Realized revenue/customer value remains separate from routing utility and is never imputed.
The V19 debt queue is advisory measurement debt only and cannot authorize routing, claiming, or allocator overrides.
